notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.
